environment_preconditions: Use the interpreter that starts the test (sys.executable), with project dependencies installed.
Caller supplies SEAL_DATABASE_URL and SEAL_S3_ENDPOINT/ACCESS_KEY/SECRET_KEY; test needs isolated CREATE DATABASE/CreateBucket permissions.
Caller supplies TESSDATA_PREFIX when OCR models are outside the Tesseract default search path.
Optional SEAL_TEST_ENV_FILE explicitly selects a POSIX shell environment file; no personal file is loaded by default.
Real source reachability is required; loopback is permitted only for isolated controlled fixtures.
business_scope: Bounded real dd-492 and dd-499, shared acquisition through Snapshot and API-only consumption
positive_contracts: real dd-492 POST pagination persists checkpoint and yields complete legal document body from original inputs
real dd-499 official stable identity and JSON/XML locator survives the 16-column API projection
controlled shared response yields multiple independent complete documents with per-document inputs
one document has ordered volumes 1..n and independently named attachment API rows
reordered/repeated discovery preserves resource identity and source_record_id
unrelated document mutation in shared input does not create an unchanged document Version
document without independent original remains consumable when valid archived body is its source
absence of public_url does not prevent CAS and API bytes
all 16 API fields reconcile with SQL; every Markdown/original API byte equals CAS and its SHA-256
planning-only pagination/conditions changes preserve document versions and fingerprints
duplicate candidates persist valid task keys and deliver once; enqueue/worker completes the persisted run
failure_boundaries: required attachment unavailable -> explicit failure and no partial success delivery
body fails objective quality threshold -> explicit failure and no gibberish success
source structure changes or lacks legal full text -> explicit failure
remaining next_page after page cap -> explicit known_gap and incomplete enumeration
API/SQL fields or API/CAS bytes differ from their recorded identity -> failure
JSON Pointer/XML XPath does not resolve to archived original input -> failure
reporting_contract: selected scope; discovered/original-acquired/parsed/quality-passed/API-consumable counts; failures; full-history denominator UNKNOWN; no credentials or personal data in artifacts
